_schema.why: The single register of reviews performed by PEOPLE — a teacher, a subject specialist, a curriculum officer — and of classroom trials. scripts/validation-status.mjs reads it and refuses a claim in OPENMIND_SCOPE.json that is larger than this file. Nothing here may be written by a model or by an author about their own work: an entry is evidence only with a name, a role and a date, and the reviewer must be able to refuse to be listed.

kinds.items: an item-level review; the per-concept record lives in audit/item-reviews.json and is cross-checked there
kinds.lesson: a qualified person reviewed one lesson's teaching sequence and materials
kinds.curriculum: a qualified person reviewed a sequence of lessons against a named curriculum
kinds.classroom: a real class was taught and assessed; recorded separately because it is not a document review

fields.targetId: concept id, pathway id, or trial id — never a free-text description
fields.reviewer: the person's name; an organisation is not a person
fields.role: what qualifies them to judge this (subject teacher, head of department, curriculum officer)
fields.date: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the review was completed
fields.notes: what they said, in their words or a faithful summary they have seen
fields.artifact: path to the review form they completed, or null when the note is the record

_schema.rule: An entry with no reviewer name, no date, or no role is NOT a review and scripts/validation-status.mjs fails on it.
